messages.subject: Re: Precision matrix
parts:
myResult = inla(formula,
                    data=inla.stack.data(total.stack, spde=mySPDE),
                    family="gaussian",
                    control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(total.stack), compute=TRUE),
                    control.compute=list(cpo=TRUE));

Enter the command: names(myResult);

myResult$Q : Will return precision matrix
